name: Pixel Photonics
description: Pixel Photonics develops waveguide-integrated superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs) that combine high detection efficiency with scalability. Spun off from the University of Münster, the company's detectors serve quantum computing, quantum communication, and LiDAR applications, and are backed by BMBF, EIC, and ESA funding.

products.name: Waveguide-Integrated SNSPDs
products.description: Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors integrated on photonic waveguides for high-efficiency detection

news.title: Pixel Photonics receives €1 million SPRIND funding for multi-mode single photon detection
news.excerpt: The deep-tech startup Pixel Photonics receives a grant of 1 million euros from the German Federal Agency for Breakthrough Innovation (SPRIND) to further develop its waveguide-integrated superconducting nanowire single photon detectors (WI-SNSPDs) for multi-mode detection.

news.title: Pixel Photonics Picked as Sub-Contractor For Photonic Quantum Computer Project
news.excerpt: Pixel Photonics, a start-up out of the WWU Münster, was chosen as sub-contractor for a 14 million euros development contract from the DLR. The project, led by quantum computing start-up QuiX, has the goal to develop a photonic quantum computer with a minimum of 64 qubits.
